title: How to Use Internet
description: Learn the fundamentals of internet usage.

materials.content: The internet is a global network connecting millions of computers.

choices.comment: The internet connects much more than phones.
Correct! The internet is a global computer network.
Websites are only one service on the internet.

questions.question: Which device can access the internet?

choices.comment: Correct! Laptops can connect to the internet.
A stone cannot access the internet.
